name: OPPORTUNITY
summary: 4 participants · wearable, object and ambient sensors
scope: One complete original archive supports both the gesture-recognition and locomotion tasks. It includes recordings, label definitions, documentation and the original benchmark tools.
creators: Daniel Roggen, Alberto Calatroni, Long-Van Nguyen-Dinh, Ricardo Chavarriaga, Hesam Sagha and the OPPORTUNITY consortium
license_note: Retain the original consortium credits and notices. The original README requests the Roggen et al. 2010 dataset paper or the Chavarriaga et al. 2013 benchmark paper; both are supplied below.
citation:
Daniel Roggen et al. Collecting complex activity data sets in highly rich networked sensor environments. INSS, 2010.
Ricardo Chavarriaga et al. The Opportunity challenge: A benchmark database for on-body sensor-based activity recognition. Pattern Recognition Letters, 2013.
